name: Gemma 4 Multi-LoRA Enterprise Release Gate Dataset
description: Verifies exact tool trajectory and response factuality across SRE, FinOps, and SecOps LoRA adapters.

parts.text: Service checkout-api in us-central1 is throwing 14.8% HTTP 5xx errors over the last 15 minutes. Diagnose the spike and provide the remediation command.

Root cause for checkout-api in us-central1 (14.8% 5xx, p99 4820ms): Container concurrency limit (80) saturated by blocking synchronous DB calls. Remediation: gcloud run services update checkout-api --region=us-central1 --concurrency=200 --cpu=4 --memory=8Gi
Our Cloud Run GPU service gemma4-multilora-vllm has 21.5% GPU utilization. Right-size it to target concurrency 16 and min-instances 0.

Right-sized gemma4-multilora-vllm to target_concurrency=16 and min_instances=0, increasing GPU utilization from 21.5% to 78.4% and saving $1480.00/month. Command: gcloud run services update gemma4-multilora-vllm --region=us-central1 --concurrency=16 --min-instances=0
Service account legacy-worker-sa@prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com was granted roles/editor in production. Quarantine it and revoke roles/editor immediately.

Quarantined legacy-worker-sa@prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com under policy SEC-IAM-LEAST-PRIV-004: revoked roles/editor and bound replacement role roles/run.invoker (status: QUARANTINED_AND_REMEDIATED).
